name: jaysylvester.com
description: Source code from my personal site

scripts.dev:destroy: docker compose --env-file .env -p jaysylvester-dev -f compose.yaml -f compose.dev.yaml down
scripts.dev:logs: docker compose --env-file .env -p jaysylvester-dev -f compose.yaml -f compose.dev.yaml logs -f app proxy assets db
scripts.dev:restart: npm run dev:stop && npm run dev:start
scripts.dev:status: docker compose --env-file .env -p jaysylvester-dev -f compose.yaml -f compose.dev.yaml ps --all
scripts.dev:stop: docker compose --env-file .env -p jaysylvester-dev -f compose.yaml -f compose.dev.yaml stop
